section.content: The utility model discloses a biological gene extraction grinding device, and relates to the technical field of biological gene grinding. The utility model comprises a shell, wherein a cover shell is covered on the shell, a rotating motor is fixedly arranged on the top surface of the cover shell, a fixed toothed ring is fixedly arranged in the cover shell, a rotating circular plate is rotatably arranged on the bottom surface of the cover shell, two rotating shaft rods are rotatably arranged on the rotating circular plate, the rotating shaft rods extend into the shell, a plurality of crushing rollers are fixedly arranged on the rotating shaft rods, a driving gear is fixedly arranged at the top end of the rotating shaft rods and meshed with the fixed toothed ring, a rotating slat is rotatably arranged in the cover shell, the top surface of the rotating slat is fixedly connected with the driving end of the rotating motor, and the driving gear is rotatably connected with the bottom surface of the rotating slat, so that materials put into the shell can be sufficiently and uniformly crushed by grinding, and particles generated by grinding each time cannot be influenced by the previous grinding particles.

本实用新型公开了生物基因提取研磨装置，涉及生物基因研磨技术领域。本实用新型包括壳体，所述壳体上盖装有盖壳，所述盖壳的顶面固定安装有转动电机，所述盖壳内固定安装有固定齿环，所述盖壳的底面转动安装有转动圆板，所述转动圆板上转动安装有两个转动轴杆，所述转动轴杆伸入所述壳体内，所述转动轴杆上固定安装有多个粉碎辊，所述转动轴杆的顶端固定安装有驱动齿轮，所述驱动齿轮与所述固定齿环啮合，所述盖壳内转动安装有转动条板，所述转动条板的顶面与所述转动电机的驱动端固定连接，所述驱动齿轮与所述转动条板的底面转动连接，能对放入壳体中的物料进行充分均匀的研磨粉碎，使得每次研磨生成的颗粒都不会受到前次研磨颗粒影响到纯度。

Biological gene extraction grinding deviceTechnical Field

The utility model belongs to the technical field of biological gene grinding, and particularly relates to a biological gene extraction grinding device.

Background

Genes are carriers of genetic information, are most important biological information molecules, are main objects of molecular biology research, and are very important preconditions for obtaining high-molecular-weight and high-purity genome DNA for carrying out sequencing, hybridization, gene expression, library construction and other experiments, so that the extraction of the genome DNA is one of the most important and basic operations in the molecular biology test technology, and a plurality of biological samples are ground in the biological gene extraction process so as to achieve the standard of convenient extraction.

The utility model provides a biological gene extraction grinder of present patent application number CN201920273778.8, includes moving part and the hollow lower casing of cylindrical and inside, and the open-top of lower casing sets up, moving part includes that cylindrical lapping piece and axis department are equipped with vertical fenestrate cylinder, and the top of lapping piece and the bottom coaxial fixation of vertical pole, the top of vertical pole pass the vertical perforation on the cylinder and extend to the top of cylinder, and the lower part of cylinder side is equipped with the evagination screw thread, and the top of cylinder and vertical pole side pass through the interlock and connect, and the invagination screw thread has been seted up on the well upper portion of lower shells inner wall, and evagination screw thread meshes with the invagination screw thread mutually, and the diameter of lapping piece and the diameter of lower shells inner wall are equal, and the liquid hole with its inner chamber intercommunication has evenly been seted up to the bottom of lower casing, and rotation auxiliary is installed on the top of vertical pole. The biological gene extraction grinding device is convenient to clean and high in safety, and materials can not leak out during grinding.

And the above-mentioned patent is when grinding, probably can grind inadequately, grinds the granule volume size that the crushing produced for follow-up sampling test's result also can cause the influence, and the powder granule that this kind of device grinds the production can adsorb inside the device simultaneously, is difficult to clear up, causes the pollution to other materials of follow-up grinding, influences the purity of follow-up grinding.

Disclosure of utility model

The technical problem to be solved by the present utility model is to overcome the deficiencies of the prior art and provide a biological gene extraction and polishing device which can overcome or at least partially solve the above problems.

In order to solve the technical problems, the basic conception of the technical scheme adopted by the utility model is that the biological gene extraction grinding device comprises a shell, a cover shell is covered on the shell, a rotating motor is fixedly arranged on the top surface of the cover shell, a fixed toothed ring is fixedly arranged in the cover shell, a rotating circular plate is rotatably arranged on the bottom surface of the cover shell, two rotating shaft rods are rotatably arranged on the rotating circular plate, the rotating shaft rods extend into the shell, a plurality of grinding rollers are fixedly arranged on the rotating shaft rods, a driving gear is fixedly arranged at the top end of the rotating shaft rods, the driving gear is meshed with the fixed toothed ring, a rotating slat is rotatably arranged on the cover shell, the top surface of the rotating slat is fixedly connected with the driving end of the rotating motor, and the driving gear is rotatably connected with the bottom surface of the rotating slat.

In order to enable the rotating slat to drive the two driving gears to rotate synchronously, preferably, the connection part of the driving end of the rotating motor and the rotating slat is positioned at the center of the top surface of the rotating slat, and the connection part of the driving gears and the rotating slat is positioned at two ends of the bottom surface of the rotating slat.

In order to scrape the inner wall surface of the shell, preferably, a side wall scraping strip matched with the inner wall surface of the shell is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the rotating circular plate.

In order to scrape the bottom surface of the inner wall of the shell, preferably, the bottom end of the rotating shaft rod is slidably provided with a bottom scraping strip matched with the bottom surface inside the shell.

In order to enable the bottom surface scraping strip to be propped against the bottom surface of the shell, the bottom surface scraping strip comprises a rotating scraping strip and a sliding rod, the rotating scraping strip is fixedly connected with the sliding rod, the rotating scraping strip is in sliding connection with the rotating shaft rod, a telescopic spring is fixedly arranged at the top end of the rotating scraping strip, and the other end of the telescopic spring is fixedly connected with the rotating shaft rod.

In order to prevent the bottom scraping strip from rotating relative to the rotating shaft rod, further, a limiting block is fixedly arranged on the rotating scraping strip, and a limiting chute matched with the limiting block is arranged on the rotating shaft rod.

In order to enhance the grinding effect, it is preferable that the grinding rolls on the two rotating shafts are distributed to intersect.

By adopting the technical scheme, the biological gene extraction grinding device has the advantages that the two rotating shafts and the two groups of grinding rollers revolve and rotate in the shell, so that the materials placed in the shell are sufficiently and uniformly ground and crushed, the powder particles generated by grinding and crushing are fine and uniform, the subsequent test effect is improved, meanwhile, the inner wall of the shell which is difficult to clean is scraped off, the powder particles are prevented from being adsorbed in the shell, the subsequent grinding is influenced, and the purity of the particles generated by grinding each time is not influenced by the previous grinding particles.

The following describes the embodiments of the present utility model in further detail with reference to the accompanying drawings.

Drawings

In the drawings:

FIG. 2 is a schematic view of the internal structure of the present utility model;

FIG. 3 is a schematic view of the gear drive of the present utility model;

fig. 6 is a schematic view of the bottom surface wiper strip according to the present utility model.

The device comprises a shell, a cover shell, a rotating motor, a rotating circular plate, a fixed toothed ring, a rotating shaft rod, a crushing roller, a driving gear, a rotating slat, a side wall scraping bar, a bottom scraping bar, a rotating scraping bar, a sliding bar, a telescopic spring, a limiting block and a limiting block, wherein the rotating motor, the rotating circular plate, the fixed toothed ring, the rotating shaft rod, the crushing roller, the driving gear, the rotating slat, the side wall scraping bar, the bottom scraping bar, the sliding bar, the telescopic spring and the limiting block are arranged in sequence, and the sliding bar is arranged in sequence.

Detailed Description

For the purpose of making the objects, technical solutions and advantages of the embodiments of the present utility model more apparent, the technical solutions in the embodiments will be clearly and completely described with reference to the accompanying drawings in the embodiments of the present utility model, and the following embodiments are used to illustrate the present utility model, but are not intended to limit the scope of the present utility model.

Examples:

Referring to fig. 1 to 6, the biological gene extraction grinding device comprises a housing 1, a cover shell 2 is covered on the housing 1, a rotating motor 3 is fixedly arranged on the top surface of the cover shell 2, a fixed toothed ring 5 is fixedly arranged in the cover shell 2, a rotating circular plate 4 is rotatably arranged on the bottom surface of the cover shell 2, two rotating shaft rods 6 are rotatably arranged on the rotating circular plate 4, the rotating shaft rods 6 extend into the housing 1, a plurality of grinding rollers 7 are fixedly arranged on the rotating shaft rods 6, a driving gear 8 is fixedly arranged at the top ends of the rotating shaft rods 6, the driving gear 8 is meshed with the fixed toothed ring 5, a rotating slat 9 is rotatably arranged in the cover shell 2, the top surface of the rotating slat 9 is fixedly connected with the driving end of the rotating motor 3, and the driving gear 8 is rotatably connected with the bottom surface of the rotating slat 9.

The connection part of the driving end of the rotating motor 3 and the rotating slat 9 is positioned at the center of the top surface of the rotating slat 9, and the connection part of the driving gear 8 and the rotating slat 9 is positioned at the two ends of the bottom surface of the rotating slat 9, so that the rotating slat 9 can drive the two driving gears 8 to synchronously rotate.

The bottom end of the rotary circular plate 4 is fixedly provided with a side wall scraping strip 10 matched with the inner wall surface of the shell 1, when the rotary circular plate 4 rotates, the side wall scraping strip 10 is driven to rotate, the side wall scraping strip 10 scrapes and washes the inner wall surface of the shell 1, and powder generated by grinding is prevented from being adsorbed on the inner wall surface of the shell 1.

The bottom sliding mounting of the rotating shaft lever 6 has the bottom surface scraping bar 11 matched with the inside bottom surface of the shell 1, the bottom surface scraping bar 11 comprises a rotating scraping bar 111 and a sliding bar 112, the rotating scraping bar 111 is fixedly connected with the sliding bar 112, the rotating scraping bar 111 is in sliding connection with the rotating shaft lever 6, the top end of the rotating scraping bar 111 is fixedly provided with a telescopic spring 113, the other end of the telescopic spring 113 is fixedly connected with the rotating shaft lever 6, the rotating scraping bar 111 is fixedly provided with a limiting block 114, the rotating shaft lever 6 is provided with a limiting chute matched with the limiting block 114, the rotating shaft lever 6 and the bottom surface scraping bar 11 are integrated with the cover shell 2, when the cover shell 2 is covered on the shell 1, the telescopic spring 113 compresses, the sliding bar 112 is tightly attached to the bottom surface of the inner wall of the shell 1, and when the rotating shaft lever 6 rotates and revolves, the bottom surface scraping bar 11 scrapes the bottom surface of the inner wall of the shell 1, and powder generated by grinding is prevented from being adsorbed on the bottom surface of the inner wall of the shell 1.

The crushing rollers 7 on the two rotating shafts 6 are distributed in a crossed manner, the distance between the crushing rollers 7 is reduced by the crossed distribution, and the grinding and crushing effect is improved.

According to the utility model, the rotating motor 3 drives the rotating lath 9 to rotate, the rotating lath 9 drives the driving gear 8 to rotate, the driving gear 8 drives the rotating shaft rod 6 to revolve in the shell 1, meanwhile, the rotating circular plate 4 is also driven by the rotating shaft rod 6, the driving gear 8 is meshed with the fixed toothed ring 5, and the driving gear 8 rotates when revolving, so that the rotating shaft rod 6 and the crushing roller 7 revolve in the shell 1 and rotate, materials in the shell 1 are ground and crushed, meanwhile, the rotating circular plate 4 rotates to drive the side wall scraping strip 10 to scrape the inner wall surface of the shell 1, and the bottom surface scraping strip 11 is driven by the rotating shaft rod 6 to rotate to scrape the inner wall bottom surface of the shell 1.

Under the scraping of the side wall scraping strip 10 and the bottom surface scraping strip 11, the inner wall surface of the shell 1 is not adsorbed with powder particles, the subsequent grinding is not affected, and only the rotating shaft rod 6 and the crushing roller 7 which are integrated with the cover shell 2 are required to be taken down from the shell 1, so that the shell is conveniently exposed to the outside, is easy to clean, and can not affect the subsequent grinding.

The above embodiments are only preferred embodiments of the present utility model, and the present utility model is not limited in any way, although the present utility model has been described above with reference to the preferred embodiments, but is not limited thereto, any person skilled in the art who is familiar with the present patent shall cover the protection scope of the present utility model without departing from the scope of the technical proposal of the present utility model and the equivalents or changes of the technical proposal and the inventive concept thereof.
